items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: I think the truest band is the Artie Shaw Band. Because Artie Shaw runs it.

ctx.x: I think the Basie band is probably the truest to — at least they have a steady personnel. Some of the other ones come in and use local guys sometimes.
Well I think that’s right. But I think the truest band is the Artie Shaw Band. Because Artie Shaw runs it.
I was not aware of that.
